author: agent
scope: Original generic grey brick with running bond, mortar and small pores. Colour, bond, dimensions and relief are design estimates; not recovered measurements or exact masonry layout of Jinshanwei.

uv_contract.vertical_faces: U=continuous horizontal metres/1.28; V=-height metres/0.64. Keep UVs unbounded with REPEAT. Do not normalize individual wall parts.
uv_contract.horizontal_faces: Apply the same 1.28m by0.64m metric repeat in a consistent architectural plane frame; this is a generic bond, not surveyed paving.
uv_contract.normal_encoding: normalize(-dH/dU_metres, +dH/dPNG_row_metres, 1); PNG row index increases downwards.
uv_contract.current_web_contract: No TANGENT. Three GLTFLoader negates normalScale.y for the derivative frame. Effective scale is [+0.35,-0.35]; verify on final runtime.
uv_contract.blender_contract: Standard importer changes V to1-V without inverting the normal green channel. Do not add another flip.
uv_contract.if_tangents_added: Re-audit tangent basis and loader; this contract is for absent TANGENT.

periodicity: All row/cell indices close on the8-by4 brick grid. Fourier phases, smoothing, pore deposits and derivatives wrap on a torus; opposite pixel-centre edges need not be duplicate pixels.
height_not_geometry: Encoded relief is normal shading attenuated by0.35, not physical displaced bricks or collision geometry.
